@Bettina Kroll: Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday, 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". So the handover date is **Monday, November 3, 2025**.

That digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. The Coastal cheat sheet lists PHL under Coastal, and Kwame is an account manager on the team. I found no contract or CRM file for the account, so the digest is my only source for the date. If the tracker needs a formal ownership-change record, check it against that.
